title: Tails, You Win
supportedClaims: In many money systems, a small number of outsized wins explain most of the total result.
The distribution is lumpy, so average-looking stretches can hide the fact that only a few decisions or assets do most of the heavy lifting.
The reader is encouraged to diversify, stay in the game long enough to catch winners, and avoid overreacting to ordinary misses.
caution: Tail rewards are real, but the search for them can become reckless if it ignores survival and position sizing.
